description: For a person without an account: create a pending agent connection and a Stripe-hosted Checkout link for the plan (release planner, new-showtime alerts and reminders). $4.99/mo after a 7-day free trial; everything included; the human confirms on Stripe; agents never handle cards. Show the URL to the human; only they can confirm on Stripe. Keep the returned token private. Do not call repeatedly or for an existing subscriber.
